summary:
Implemented Phase 1 LLM fact-distillation arm for the agent-memory bench harness. Three files changed on branch orch/attempt/59fc18e1-744e-4f7a-9093-a8e12d43087b-42 (commit f0e4a36):

1. bench/agent-memory/distill.py — new module. Adds ConversationDistiller class (drop-in for ConversationIngester: same workspace_for/ingest interface) and distill_session() function. Calls claude -p via subprocess (stdin pattern from probe_runner.py) with an atomic-fact extraction prompt that enforces: one subject-predicate-object claim per fact, names/dates/numbers kept, relative time resolved against session_date, category:preference for standing user preferences. JSON parse is robust (handles markdown fences, trailing commas, prose preamble). Phase 1 dedup: ADD-only, daemon dup-guard handles duplicates.

2. bench/agent-memory/probe_runner.py — adds run_probe_distill(base_url, workspace, conv_id, probe) which searches the distilled-fact workspace and answers via the same _answer_from_context template, returning arm='distill' records.

3. bench/agent-memory/run.py — adds 'distill' to valid_arms set; imports ConversationDistiller and run_probe_distill; creates a ConversationDistiller with a sibling workspace root (workspace_root/distill/) when distill is in arms; passes distiller to _run_conv; _run_conv updated to run both standard and distill paths per probe.

Smoke test: ran --benchmark locomo --limit 1 --arms distill --skip-score. Extracted 6 atomic facts across 3 sessions (session 1 had no user-stated facts — correct). Facts wrote as note nodes with vectors. 2 distill probe records written to results.jsonl. Run completed cleanly, no errors.

subject: Phase 1 distiller: replace raw-session-chunk ingest with LLM fact-distillation (session → atomic facts → notes); prove on LME-S + LoCoMo before scaling
description:
First structural increment from docs/conversational-memory-design.md. Replace the bench's raw-session-chunk ingest with an LLM DISTILLER: each session → atomic, self-contained facts → notes (via post_note/createNote). Pure additive write path — zero engine changes, can't break the task graph.

THE DISTILLER (the core deliverable): `distill_session(turns, session_date)` → a tool-less `claude -p` call → a list of ATOMIC facts. Each fact must be:
- SELF-CONTAINED and SPECIFIC — preserve names, dates, numbers, proper nouns (e.g. "Business Administration", "The Glass Menagerie", "45 minutes each way", "Caroline"). These are exactly the specifics chunk-RAG buried (#39 retrieval misses).
- RELATIVE-TIME RESOLVED — resolve "yesterday"/"last week"/"this month" against session_date into an absolute date IN the fact text (#39 had "lost job yesterday" in the Jan-20 session → emit "lost banker job on 2023-01-19").
- one discrete fact per note (not a session summary, not a raw chunk).
Honesty bar: the distiller reads ONLY the session content — NO gold answers, NO evidence labels.

Wire it as an ingest option (a distill path in the bench ingest / ConversationIngester or the embedded-daemon ingest) and write the distilled facts as the notes the arms retrieve over.

PROVE IT FIRST (bounded — do NOT run the full slice yet): distill + run probes on (a) ONE LongMemEval-S conversation that was a #39 retrieval MISS — 118b2229 "How long is my daily commute?" gold "45 minutes each way" — does distillation now surface the needle? and (b) LoCoMo conv-26. LLM-judge the probes, compare to the #40 chunk-RAG baseline (LoCoMo 33.3%, LME-S 40%). Report: did distilled-fact memory recover the misses? If yes, it's ready to scale to the full slice.

HANG AVOIDANCE: prove on ~2 conversations only, foreground chunks ≤10 min each (distilling ~19-50 sessions per conv + a few probes), NO run_in_background, NO poll loop. ORCH_HEADLESS_DRAINS=0; note-decay ON. Flat task off main.

subject: Phase 1 distiller: replace raw-session-chunk ingest with LLM fact-distillation (session → atomic facts → notes); prove on LME-S + LoCoMo before scaling
description:
First structural increment from docs/conversational-memory-design.md. Replace the bench's raw-session-chunk ingest with an LLM DISTILLER: each session → atomic, self-contained facts → notes (via post_note/createNote). Pure additive write path — zero engine changes, can't break the task graph.

THE DISTILLER (the core deliverable): `distill_session(turns, session_date)` → a tool-less `claude -p` call → a list of ATOMIC facts. Each fact must be:
- SELF-CONTAINED and SPECIFIC — preserve names, dates, numbers, proper nouns (e.g. "Business Administration", "The Glass Menagerie", "45 minutes each way", "Caroline"). These are exactly the specifics chunk-RAG buried (#39 retrieval misses).
- RELATIVE-TIME RESOLVED — resolve "yesterday"/"last week"/"this month" against session_date into an absolute date IN the fact text (#39 had "lost job yesterday" in the Jan-20 session → emit "lost banker job on 2023-01-19").
- one discrete fact per note (not a session summary, not a raw chunk).
Honesty bar: the distiller reads ONLY the session content — NO gold answers, NO evidence labels.

Wire it as an ingest option (a distill path in the bench ingest / ConversationIngester or the embedded-daemon ingest) and write the distilled facts as the notes the arms retrieve over.

PROVE IT FIRST (bounded — do NOT run the full slice yet): distill + run probes on (a) ONE LongMemEval-S conversation that was a #39 retrieval MISS — 118b2229 "How long is my daily commute?" gold "45 minutes each way" — does distillation now surface the needle? and (b) LoCoMo conv-26. LLM-judge the probes, compare to the #40 chunk-RAG baseline (LoCoMo 33.3%, LME-S 40%). Report: did distilled-fact memory recover the misses? If yes, it's ready to scale to the full slice.

HANG AVOIDANCE: prove on ~2 conversations only, foreground chunks ≤10 min each (distilling ~19-50 sessions per conv + a few probes), NO run_in_background, NO poll loop. ORCH_HEADLESS_DRAINS=0; note-decay ON. Flat task off main.
